Malaysia (Subsidiari Perbadanan) (Pemakaian) 2017.

(2) Perintah ini berkuat kuasa pada 8 Februari 2017.

MALAYSIA DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION ACT 2011

MALAYSIA DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION (SUBSIDIARY OF THE CORPORATION)
(APPLICATION) ORDER 2017

IN exe rcise of the powers conferred by subsection 10(2) of the
Malaysia Deposit Insurance Corporation Act 2011 [ Act 720 ], the Corporation, with the
approval of  the Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1)  This order may be cited as the Malaysia Deposit Insurance Corporation
(Subsidiary of the Corporation) (Application) Order 2017.

 (2)  This Order comes into operation on 8 February 2017.

Application of provisions of the Act
2. The provision s of the Act  specified in column (3)  of the Schedule shall apply to
the subsidiary of the Corporation specified in column (2)  as if the subsidiary  of
the Corporation is the Corporation itself.

SCHEDULE
